business_problem: LAB3 needed to modernize service management so support engineers were not spending a week chasing follow-ups, validating request items manually, and answering routine queries instead of delivering higher-value customer service.
solution_summary: LAB3 standardized service delivery on the ServiceNow AI Platform instead of building separate AI tooling in house. It deployed Now Assist across IT Service Management, Customer Service Management, and Creator so engineers could generate case summaries, resolution notes, and workflow logic from natural-language prompts. Customer requests enter through a hybrid service portal and Microsoft Teams, where AI Search returns personalized answers and deflects common requests before they hit the desk. When work does become a case, ITSM and CSM route it through Agent Workspace with AI context already attached, reducing follow-up traffic and speeding handoffs between responders and managers. LAB3 also used Creator AI features to generate app and workflow code more quickly, helping junior developers build and automate service processes without compromising security for regulated customers.

data_flow: Customer and employee questions arrive through the service portal or Microsoft Teams, where AI Search and Now Assist answer or classify requests first. Unresolved work is routed through ITSM and CSM into Agent Workspace, where engineers use generated summaries and notes to resolve cases faster, while Creator AI accelerates the supporting workflow and app logic behind the scenes.
business_outcome: LAB3 cut mean time to resolution by 47%, reduced workflow bottlenecks by 46%, improved self-service rates by 20%, shortened request validation by 37%, and reported a 100x increase in service-portal usage while onboarding junior developers in weeks instead of months.
